name: pump-io-shape
title: F5 pump I/O shape: speculative batched read and event-driven idle wake
description: Structural finding F5 of 09-29-tcp-udp-path-structural-perf: NdisApiDriver.TryReadPackets issues a GetAdapterPacketQueueSize query IOCTL before every batched ReadPackets, so under load every batch pays two IOCTLs and at idle every adapter pays one query per ~1 ms poll; the pump paces empty polls with Thread.Sleep(1). Measured baseline: ~1.8% of a core per idle second and a 0.078 ms median wake; the read side has no IOCTL counting behind the driver seam.
creator: qmazon
